title: §0 premises read off the exchange
summary: Premises of the base read off a supplied law of exchange. Dissipation, embodiment and transmission are states of the law. Requirement is response where several exchanges are open.

title: §1.1 one unfolding read in context
summary: Relational identity and readings: a configuration is how it relates, separation loses exactly the relation, process and frame are readings of one unfolding, unity of readings, every base is a run, histories fix the law up to dead ends, trace and step-law equivalence, gluing under parity, context coherence, control-coherence loss, endpoint loss, joint-correlation reduction, and finite-trace transport (periphery).
note: Root candidates. Need restating on the Grammar root.

title: §1.2 laws of every law of change
summary: Recurrence under every law of change and without decidedness, attraction is not returning, possibly vs necessarily drawn, determinacy up to likeness, every loss passes a juncture, every origin passes the gate, lifting where branching is finite, coming and ceasing keep pace, what a commuting law keeps apart, and where a run goes on. All without premise.

title: §1.3 counting, census and the rest theorem
summary: The tally is the whole law of counting. Also: counting is a relation, counts exist where decided, the census balance (also under a continuation and read off the exchange), relata counted up to indiscernibility, listing once is decided identity, laws at coarser steps and finer units, time as a tower of discrete readings, and the map of premises. The rest theorem: openness is needed; rest under dissipation at every resolution, in any amounts and exactly where falls stop; rest from a finite reading; least loss as a premise of rest; refinement counted as a giving.
note: The counting and identity laws go to root. The rest-theorem rows go to map (rest and settling).

title: Balance derived from physics: first law, continuity, entropy production
summary: Balance from the first law (periphery) and balance from conservation along a relation (core). Least loss from entropy production (periphery). These ground the World premise of balance in physical laws.
note: Unique physical grounding of a base premise. Fits root (premises as one model) or method (relation to known results, §8.7).

title: §1.4 laws of one step, order of exchange, sum over histories
summary: The laws of one step and their completeness, what they miss, independent exchanges commute unless joined, the order of exchanges is the invariant, only the order of change shows, normal forms need decided apartness, least footprint, the exact sum over histories and its losses, the step index from own courses, and interleavings building a world.

title: In one sentence: what the Theory of Becoming explains
summary: How relations form, persist, transform, degenerate and dissolve within one relational unfolding, and how life, evolution, knowing and evaluation differentiate within it, without assuming becoming is good.
note: candidate opening line of the new root chapter

title: Ten central results list
summary: Ten results carrying the argument: one change three readings; recurrence and attraction; premises carve parts; rest needs least loss or finite reading; order of what can form; closures and selection; joint excess and relative position; learning and identification; significance not in the dynamics; loops. None is new mathematics.
note: index into §1-§6; each listed again in its section; regroup by new regions

title: Representation: discrete steps, one shared index
summary: Activity, level, exchange indexed by natural-number steps; no causal order beyond the index assumed; for local exchanges index read off own courses; real-valued time represented exactly for balance (Representation.Course.sample_balances, givenOver_coarse, XL2 study §365); within-step change not shown.
note: overlaps §1.4; say once

title: Representation: natural-number amounts and what depends on it
summary: Levels, needs, takes, gives are naturals; least loss, loop doubling, novelty-needs-gain depend on it; general form Amounts.rests; in any amounts rest needs the census total to stop falling; no whole reading of an endlessly falling amount; over reals novelty needs gain exactly at least separation, held/damped loop laws.
note: duplicates §1.3 rest-in-any-amounts content

title: Representation: Prop-valued activity, one kind of relatum, roles, thresholds, identity, pointwise
summary: active : Nat → F → Prop (counting laws need decidedness; some laws exactly EM); one kind of relatum with flow and web, formations and conditions as roles (World.ofRoles); shared index of conditions by relabel; requirements as thresholds need ≤ level; identity across steps by naming; pointwise properties since no funext (Counts.unique).

title: The eight World premises
summary: Activity needing support (Dependent), balance, only active give (Acting), only active take from what they draw on (Taking), dissipation (least whole-unit loss), embodiment, census (Counted), bounded transmission; weaker forms Carried and ArisingEmbodied; World.acting_across.
note: to become one model of the grammar

title: Premises contingent and independent
summary: Seven premises each met and failed by some worlds (World.contingent); the eight independent (World.independent, World.none_follows); in hatch all hold and bind (World.hatch_binds); no finite world binds the census. Independence measures freedom of World's fields, not contingency in becoming.

title: Premises read off one exchange: five by construction, three states of the law
summary: With the rest counted, balance, only-active giving/taking and (for a law) activity-needing-support hold by construction; balance holds iff rest never active, iff course feasible (nothing from nothing located in the law); census where a named family closes each step, LPO at every step; dissipation, embodiment, transmission are loss, no dormancy, heredity of response.
note: root re-rooting work (E1); unique, carry

title: Balance from conservation along a relation and first-law reading
summary: Levels balance exactly where no store generates entropy (balances_iff_stores_generate_nothing); over finitely many relata, balancing transfers along a relation exist iff total conserved on every family the relation closes (Continuity.balancing_iff, conservedOn_of_law; FL2 study §354).

title: Requirement over open exchanges: necessary response as weakest sound reading
summary: Requirement read as necessary response gives activity-needing-support on every run, possible response does not; necessary response is the weakest such reading not reading the current level; a noisy law is a relation of exchange (XL4, study §369).

title: Central laws over every relation of exchange
summary: Each of 33 central declarations taking balance or activity premises holds over what is read off an exchange with those premises discharged (Becoming.OverExchange; XL1, study §364); what remains a hypothesis is a state of the law; K3 checks every form.

title: Block D: process and correspondence premises
summary: Process as a view of the one unfolding; observables, formation E, connection (Valuation.Connected, given by common conditions/interaction) as application obligations; readings of living (whole-run, stepwise, relation level), a disclosed choice no comparison uses; Held reads 'what wants its continuation' [D11]; 生生 read as generation generating generation compared by widening [D1].
note: correspondence rows belong to significance/method; process row to root

title: Not assumed
summary: Not assumed: becoming is good; inevitable improvement or growth; fixed common utility; independent owners of value; every change generative; a definite global causal order (only order of change used).

title: One unfolding and its views (process, frame, world)
summary: Start is one unfolding of relata; process, frame, world are views returning to it: a move is part of the configuration, a law read off its history, a claim a relatum; the base is the run, a world is a run by its type. World is the view where views glue, not the start.
note: core of the new root; to be restated over Becoming.Grammar

title: A history fixes the law it shows
summary: Every history is a run of the least law it runs; a prior law adds only moves not taken; laws up to dead ends correspond to splice-closed families of histories.

title: The move is part of the unfolding; a world is a run
summary: Reading the move within the configuration changes no run (withMove_determined_iff); a world balances iff its levels run by the law of exchange (World.balances_iff_exchange); World is a run of the all-steps process, Web F C = Dependence Nat F C by rfl.

title: A configuration is how it relates (likeness by bisimulation)
summary: Bisimilar configurations are alike; a description makes sense iff it identifies alike configurations, then unique and carries a law; tests fix likeness where frames determined (alike_iff_sameTests) and constructively for finite decided frames.

title: Separation loses the relation
summary: Describing two parts separately recovers the whole iff the whole is rectangular, else loses exactly the relation (extra combinations); three parts can be related while every two are free.
note: key nondual result for root

title: Readings of §1.1: law and history, pair as least split
summary: Law and history one unfolding read two ways; gap is memory, splice is its absence; action not a second cause; names carry nothing; root is the run; a pair is by relation, the least split not the least relation (Motion.neither_alone).

title: One change, three readings; coming and ceasing keep pace
summary: change_readings (Iff.rfl) and over_stretch tally with no premise; finitely many falling conditions keep rising (rising_recurs); finite decided worlds: arising recurs iff ceasing does; Accretion and Attrition show finiteness does the work.
note: central result 1

title: Recurrence: lossless iff every configuration returns
summary: Within finitely many configurations a determined law merges nothing iff every configuration returns; keeping history admits only that history and never returns (Run.keepHistory_shown, Becoming.Recurrence).
note: central result 2

title: Gate, onward, commuting laws
summary: Every origin passes a decided gate (Gated.origin; DNE if gate is a proposition); within finitely many configurations a run exists iff a course reaches a return, no choice (run_iff_continues, run_iff_returning; searchedRun; in general exactly dependent choice); a law commuting with a moving map never merges a configuration with its image (symmetry breaking needed to merge).

title: Counting where the counts exist
summary: A count is a relation existing iff what it counts is decided; census counts are a tally and counting laws hold under each premise subset, enclosure, finite worlds; with decided activity under each of 256 subsets laws are tally or tally plus nothing-arising; bounded census keeps pace even infinitely; in general exactly EM.

title: Readings of §1.3: theorems to the whole, premises to parts
summary: Theorems belong to the whole, premises to parts; living is one part; 生起/止息 name activity starting/stopping, kept apart from generative/degenerative which do not overlap; a count is a relation; stepwise self-drawing verdict unused by comparisons.

title: Resolution and coarser-step records listed under §1.3
summary: imbalance-as-relatum, rest-at-every-resolution, rest-with-refinement-counted, laws-at-finer-units, laws-at-coarser-steps, continuous-time-as-tower: listed only as records, not argued in text.
note: content not stated in chapter; check records for whether to carry into map or method

title: Order of change: disjoint exchanges commute
summary: Commuting neighbouring exchanges with disjoint footprints keeps premises and reaches exactly renumberings keeping the partial order of joined exchanges; stuttering and idle-step removal keep premises; least footprint iff idleness decided; normal form needs decided apartness (Becoming.OrderNormal).

title: Step index from own courses; interleavings and renumbering
summary: Local laws; own courses fix configuration and fix the interleaving iff every two exchanges share a relatum; scheduler completes iff an interleaving exists; interleavings build balanced Worlds; index map makes standings read through own steps interleaving-invariant; where every exchange touches a relatum one renumbering carries one world to the other; apart relata differ (Pair.apart_differs); around-footprint keeps only identity.
note: Becoming.Interleavings (R1)

title: Laws of one step; sum over histories
summary: A one-step pattern is realized iff it obeys the every-step law and each named local condition; running down adds continuity at positive levels; sum over histories equals stepwise transfer, exact preservation is one-step lumpability, with boundary witnesses.

title: Not shown about the step index
summary: No Foata/unbounded normal form, continuous time, separate read/change footprints, endless courses, untouched exchanges, between-steps activity reading, whether every becoming has a local law (§8.5), whole-run counts. Reading [D30, D43]: index is a reading of relations, derived where exchanges share relata, else a representation choice moving only where apart standings fall.

title: Prelude and EdgeClosure: closure from a seed
summary: The Prelude states each lemma on numbers, lists and options once, by recursion and without propext. EdgeClosure: reach from a seed contains the seed, is closed under the edges and lies within every kept property. The core's closure of a relation equals this closure (withinClosure_iff_closure, reach_iff_withinClosure). No premise is needed.

title: Core terms: unfolding, relatum roles, run, views, law, configuration, exchange, web
summary: The one relational unfolding. Formation and condition are two roles of one relatum (Web.roles, relabel). A run is an infinite execution. Process, frame and world are views. A law is a rule of change read off its history (shown_le_iff). Exchange and balance; support and admission; the dependence web. Chinese renderings: 展开, 生成/变化 (D2, D45).
note: Stated on the old World base; the new root is Becoming.Grammar

title: obs as second supplied relation, derivable from dependence (OB1)
summary: Coupling laws read obs (level coupling into a formation); it derives from dependence where response rises with level or level has a complement at fixed total; a genuine second relation only for falling response with no complement.
unit: canonical-3: THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md lines 445-701 (§4 Collective dynamics, §5 How evaluation forms, §6 Significance, comparison and practical judgment)

title: T8 thesis: one relational unfolding
summary: Thesis, argued. Whatever is, is how it relates within one unfolding, and every distinction is drawn along relations. The representation needs only relations (identifiesAlike_iff, shown_le_iff, separation_faithful_iff). Five World premises hold by construction of a reading of one exchange and three are states of its law, and the central laws hold over exchange. This shows that no independent entity is needed, not that none exists. Neighbours: ontic structural realism, Whitehead, pratityasamutpada.
note: Its formal evidence is on the World base. Restate on Becoming.Grammar so the root chapter can state the thesis directly.

title: §8.1 item 1: one base, and the laws over every law of exchange
summary: The base is one by definition (R28). The World family reaches the Process family and not conversely (families_reach_each_other). The other directions hold by construction (R43). The shared index is a reading for interleavings (R38, R46); a law reading relata no exchange connects stays on a chosen interleaving. XL1: the 33 central declarations have forms over exchange (Becoming.OverExchange). Open: which law holds (item 7) and the representation (item 6).
note: The new architecture (World as one model of Becoming.Grammar) supersedes this framing. Carry the exchange results; retire the R38 connectivity counts (925 statements, 503 of 11,552) as history.

title: §8.1 item 8: identity from continuity, not naming
summary: R48: arising is forced along continuations exactly on counts. Material continuity is read by conservation, which fixes identity except where standings coincide. R49: renewing and consuming classes along splits and merges. R50: tenure and undermining along a continuation; where standings coincide, no record decides. The formal part is settled for conservation-read continuations. Open: informational and organizational continuations.
note: Root: continuation relative to a class; the grammar's lines and families should absorb this.

title: §8.5 deductive necessity of the whole / internal relations
summary: The open part of the warrant: the determinations are internally related moments of one unfolding. This is argued for the World premises' determinations (four ties hold by what the readings are). Open: every becoming has such an exchange law (items 6, 7). Requirement reduces to one step: necessary response is the weakest reading not reading the current level (ExchangeRelation.respondsBelow_weakest).
source: THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md, §8.5 first bullet, line 1401; §8.9 internal-relations bullet, line 1490
note: Duplicated by the §8.9 objection 'internal-relations thesis'.

title: Candidate statement: activity forms, sustains, transforms and dissolves operative relations in one unfolding
summary: Generation, loss and mixed consequences belong to one unfolding. Organization, life, inherited change, knowing and evaluation are differentiated achievements whose relations must be explained, not named substances. The temporal order an explanation uses must be warranted, not read off the order a model lists events in.
note: duplicates the canonical chapter §1; the root chapter should state it once

title: The whole is wider than its generative forms
summary: The foundational deduction concerns Becoming as a whole and must not require every becoming to be generative. Generation, persistence, transformation, degeneration and dissolution can overlap in one activity. A loss need not become beneficial or produce a successor; whether a change is generative is a substantive question.
source: BECOMING-FOUNDATION.md, The whole and its generative forms; §1; §9 opening
note: stated by the canonical chapter §1 (whole and manifold), as the chapter's own status note says

title: Context coherence: pooling steps preserves histories iff the union is closed under joining at the shared boundary
summary: For a nonempty family of processes over the same state and event interpretations, pooling their steps preserves exactly the union of endpoint histories if and only if that union is closed under joining at the shared represented boundary. Otherwise pooling invents unsupported histories. The positive construction retains the operative context, and the context can change by a joint event.
note: the record now states it; pre-spine module (20 theorems, one propext); credits NFA union (Sipser)

title: Completion audit: remaining inference for each whole-scope requirement
summary: For one unfolding, formed conditions, life, evolution and evaluation, strong zero-axiom warrant, and kept failures, it states what remains: establish relational unity and differentiation; explain each mode through its relations; earn interfaces; deduce the substantive whole claim; narrow claims on genuine counterexamples.
note: the evidence column is superseded by the theorem map; the remaining-inference column is unique

title: Operative relations and causal order: no definite order required at every interface
summary: Separates calculation order, implementation timing and the causal order attributed to operations. A definite causal order must not be required at every interface (quantum switch, Branciard). A continuing effect is a relation to establish, not a universal memory postulate.
note: the chapter says the records now state §7

title: Three claims compressed into 'the whole'
summary: Separates inclusive scope (an undertaking), relational unity and differentiation (constitution within one unfolding, not shared inclusion in a description), and particular operative forms (no single generative mechanism everywhere). The missing deduction lies in relational unity at whole scope. A comparison with Hegel separates the category of becoming from a supplied cause.
note: unique, per the chapter's status note

title: XL1: from inclusion to internal relation, by reading determinations off one exchange
summary: With World fields chosen separately, the eight premises are independent and the whole is a collection. Read off one exchange instead (activity as exchanging, requirement as necessary response, the rest counted as a relatum), and balance, giving only by active relata, and activity needing support become internal. The 33 central laws then hold of every exchange (OverExchange, K3).
note: study §364; the strongest root argument in this unit; restate against the grammar

title: Contingency lies in the law; differentiation is kept
summary: Closure, dissipation, embodiment, bounded transmission and enclosure are states of the exchange law, met by some laws and failed by others with the ties holding (ExchangeLaw.contingent). Requirement is a counterfactual that no course fixes. Activity and standing come apart in dormancy, and losses count where they fall.

title: Trace composition and reachability as the least reflexive-transitive closure
summary: Trace(s, u++v, t) holds iff some m has Trace(s, u, m) and Trace(m, v, t): the suffix starts where the prefix ends. Reach is the least reflexive-transitive relation containing the steps. With no steps, Reach is equality: composition manufactures no dynamics.
source: MATHEMATICAL-CORE.md, Deriving finite histories; Reachability and the precise minimality result
note: pre-spine; spine equivalents (Interleavings, Routes) likely restate these

title: Identity across steps and classes along a continuation
summary: Under a reading of holding, the class of a formation that holds throughout does not change. A re-identification keeps balance exactly where it stays within the conservation relation, and two relata that stand alike are not decided apart by any record. When more forces arising along a run is characterized exactly. Renewing and consuming read along continuations are invariant under re-identification, and a merge can flip the class. Open: sufficient conditions for a mixed census.

title: Wholes of some part, of every part, and graded wholes (WH1)
summary: Three wholes are defined. Web.Whole is active while some part is. AllWhole is active while every part is, so it ends when one part ends. The two coincide exactly where the parts are in step. Grade counts the active parts where activity is decided; an at-least-j whole arises and ceases only through a part, and a whole is diminished exactly where some parts are active but not all. 华严 and 墨经 passages are read onto these [D45].

title: Five levels of closure as one closure of a relation (EC1)
summary: Own events, feeding, influence, reach and system are one closure (WithinClosure) under five relations. A process's reach is the same closure under its steps, the inclusions can be strict, and influence and reach point in opposite directions (Trophic). One common condition makes every system the whole.

title: Which links a closure needs (cuts)
summary: Removing links leaves every closure unchanged exactly where each removed link is bypassed. In a relation grown by attachment, every link separates its ends. On the base, every condition of a world grown by attachment is needed. GrownFragmentation's cuts are periphery instances.

title: A move formed within the unfolding
summary: A move is the part's own exactly where it is formed through the part's configuration (MoveFormation).

title: Spirit, Token, Space → Yi substrate
summary: A society is spirits holding tokens in spaces. Building it showed the three are not disjoint, so it collapses to one primitive, Yi (a bare addressable root). Being is kind-bindings, truths are context-owned facts, and roles are read off context. A register of refusals (no universal table, no inherited permission). A host can operate without owning the constitution. Implemented in Bonfire.
note: Engineering ontology. It parallels the root move from separate entities to relations and classes read off a relation. Unique and not on the spine. Carry as an application; possibly an instance of the grammar's 'roles read off relations'.

title: 文 in the grammar of continuation (WL3)
summary: With a law's step as 缘 and same value as the class, 文同 is exactly that class's core (Law.core_is_sameFuture). The coarsest value-keeping class is the core. Two steps of a 文 are one state exactly when they lie in one class of its step core. The bounded laws and learnability are stated through the core. A 文 with a new value at every step has no continuation (the fire case).
source: WENLI-AND-BECOMING.md 第一部分 §一 文入续之文法
